scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:kotlin && npm run build:ruby && npm run build:csharp && npm run build:examples
scripts.build:node: npm run build --workspace=@starcruisestudios/atlas-cli && npm run build --workspace=@starcruisestudios/atlas && npm run build --workspace=@starcruisestudios/atlas-ts-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@starcruisestudios/atlas-ts-cli && npm run build --workspace=@starcruisestudios/atlas-ts-npm && npm run link:node
scripts.link:node: npm run link --workspace=@starcruisestudios/atlas-cli && npm run link --workspace=@starcruisestudios/atlas && npm run link --workspace=@starcruisestudios/atlas-ts-cli
scripts.build:examples: npm run build:example:typescript && npm run build:example:kotlin && npm run build:example:ruby && npm run build:example:csharp
scripts.view:examples: npm run view:example:typescript && npm run view:example:kotlin && npm run view:example:ruby && npm run view:example:csharp
scripts.images:examples: npm run build:examples && atlas images --workspace examples/typescript && atlas images --workspace examples/kotlin && atlas images --workspace examples/ruby && atlas images --workspace examples/csharp
scripts.view:example:typescript: npm run build:example:typescript && npm run architecture:view --workspace=@atlas-example/typescript-workspace
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:kotlin && npm run test:ruby && npm run test:csharp
scripts.lint: npm run lint:node && npm run lint:ruby
scripts.lint:ruby: npm run lint:ruby:tool && npm run lint:ruby:example
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:node && npm run format:check:ruby && npm run format:check:csharp
scripts.format:check:ruby: npm run format:check:ruby:tool && npm run format:check:ruby:example
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
